successors.name: Old Kingdom of Norway
successors.text: Iceland, sworn to the King of Norway by 1264

ledger.x: c. 930: the first Alþingi meets at Þingvellir and the commonwealth begins. 'The first Alþingi assembly convened around the year 930 at Þingvellir'; the island 'was an uninhabited island until around 874'. The page gives no frontier and no month; the island is the reading.
1264: Iceland passes to the King of Norway.

wars.name: Age of the Sturlungs and the rise of the Norwegian king's role
wars.outcome: Communal leadership gives way to dominant regional chieftains by 1220; 'the King's role in Icelandic affairs started in 1220, and had become strong by 1240'; Haakon IV is accepted in 1262 and every chieftain has sworn by 1264.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border, and no land frontier exists.
